goodsServices.description: Cutlery, namely spoons and knives, sold separately, and hand operated meat tenderizing tools; barbecue utensils, namely, forks and tongs.

Rotisserie kits consisting primarily of rod, fork, motor and balance weight; portable gas stoves; barbecue grill accessories, namely, rock grates, cooking racks, and cooking grids; barbecue grill replacement burners; barbecue grill replacement hoses and regulators and battery operated grill lights; jalapeño cooker; chicken roaster; electric bug zapper; ceramic briquettes; lava rocks; electric grill skillet; electric grill tray; grill irons.
Non-metal clips for holding table cloths on table.

Barbecue utensils, namely, spatulas and turners, sold separately and prepackaged in carrying cases; non-electric toppers for barbecue grills, namely, woks, and griddles; grilling cookware, namely, cooking skewers, wire baskets, bowls, heat and serve platters, and pots; corn cob holders; tableware, namely, paper plate holders not of precious metal, bamboo plate holders, plastic plate holders and plastic serving trays; brushes for basting meat; bottles for basting foods; grill scrapers; grill brushes for cleaning barbecue grills; grill brush replacement parts for household use; grill covers; grill grids; basting spoons; and hand-operated burger presses, namely, presses for forming meat; spice arm; spice grinder; marinade injector; basting mop; food tent; bug zapper; grill dish; grill skillet; grill pan; grill tray; umbrellas for protecting food from insects and umbrella covers; barbecue mitts.
Table cloths not made of paper; and unfitted fabric covers for outdoor furniture.
